claim: Basic mode tasks can work with up to 50 million source and destination files, objects and directories per task execution between on-premises, self-managed or other cloud storage and AWS storage services. The quota is adjustable, but instead of requesting an increase you can create tasks that focus on specific directories using include and exclude filters.
question: How many files, objects and directories can a DataSync Basic mode task work with per task execution between on-premises or other cloud storage and AWS?

qualifiers.scope: files, objects and directories per Basic mode task execution, between on-premises, self-managed or other cloud storage and AWS storage services
qualifiers.condition: S3 prefixes count as directories; instead of an increase use include and exclude filters

note: d25-070. Enhanced mode has no such quota.
